newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: APC Group rises to year high in Manila.
newsitem.headline: APC Group rises to year high in Manila.

text.p: APC Group Inc gained 0.1 centavos, or 3.33 percent, to 3.1 centavos by midsession in Manila on Thursday on reports of its conversion into a holding company from an oil company, traders said.
"Rumours that its parent firm Belle Corp plans to make APC its infrastructure arm also boosted the issue," said one local trader who requested anonymity.
APC told the Philippine Stock Exchange on Tuesday its board has approved its conversion into a holding firm.
The APC board also approved the increase in the authorised capital of APC to 20 billion pesos from the current 1.8 billion.
Around 53 million pesos worth of APC shares changed hands as of 11 a.m. local time (0300 GMT).
